title: Advisors AI Service Navigator
description: Read-only service discovery, public-page checks, and request-link preparation.
summary: Read-only service discovery, public-page checks, and request-link preparation.
offersHint: Read-only service discovery, public-page checks, and request-link preparation. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://advisorsai.ai/mcp

toolsPreview.name: advisors_catalog_list_services
toolsPreview.description: Use when a user asks what Advisors AI offers. Returns exactly five public services; do not use it to infer fit or to create an order.

toolsPreview.name: advisors_catalog_get_service
toolsPreview.description: Use after a service is identified and the user needs its published scope, limits, commercial packages, sample, and terms. Does not determine eligibility or order.

toolsPreview.name: advisors_catalog_match_service
toolsPreview.description: Use when the user describes a business need but has not chosen a service. Returns at most two deterministic routing suggestions; it is not a diagnosis or proof of fit.

toolsPreview.name: advisors_site_check_basics
toolsPreview.description: Use only when a user asks to inspect a public website. Measures bounded page, robots, structured-data, sitemap, and experimental llms.txt signals. It does not measure AI mentions, rank, visibility, firewall passage, or sales.

toolsPreview.name: advisors_order_prepare_link
toolsPreview.description: Use only after the user explicitly selects a package returned by the service tool. Returns the ordinary login/request link; it does not create an order, confirm eligibility, or charge anything.
